class IncludeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.dir = self._tmp.name

    def tearDown(self):
        self._tmp.cleanup()

    def write(self, name, text):
        path = os.path.join(self.dir, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
        return path

    def test_example_files(self):
        here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
        cfg = load(os.path.join(here, "..", "examples", "service.conf"))
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("name"), "billing")
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("level", section="logging"), "info")
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("json", section="logging"), True)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("port", section="http"), 8080)

    def test_override_order(self):
        self.write("inc.conf", "a = 1\nb = 2\n")
        path = self.write("main.conf", "a = 0\n@include inc.conf\nb = 3\n")
        cfg = load(path)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("a"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("b"), 3)

    def test_relative_to_including_file(self):
        self.write("sub/inner.conf", "x = deep\n")
        self.write("sub/mid.conf", "@include inner.conf\n")
        path = self.write("main.conf", "@include sub/mid.conf\n")
        cwd = os.getcwd()
        try:
            os.chdir(tempfile.gettempdir())
            cfg = load(path)
        finally:
            os.chdir(cwd)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.get("x"), "deep")

    def test_missing_include(self):
        path = self.write("main.conf", "@include nope.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(path)

    def test_self_cycle(self):
        path = self.write("main.conf", "@include main.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(path)

    def test_transitive_cycle(self):
        self.write("a.conf", "@include b.conf\n")
        self.write("b.conf", "@include a.conf\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(os.path.join(self.dir, "a.conf"))

    def test_same_file_twice_is_not_cycle(self):
        self.write("inc.conf", "n = 1\n")
        path = self.write("main.conf", "@include inc.conf\n@include inc.conf\n")
        self.assertEqual(load(path).get("n"), 1)
